name: Girls Inc. of Alameda County High School Programs
city: Oakland, CA (and Cal State East Bay, Hayward)
what_you_do: You can join free programs for high school girls. The page describes coding projects, college access and leadership programs. It says some programs offer paid summer internships at Bay Area companies.
who_can_apply: Girls and young women in grades 9 to 12. Programs run at the Simpson Center in Oakland (year-round) and Cal State East Bay in Hayward (summer).
pay_detail: Programs are free to families. Some pay a stipend ($150 for summer HEAL). Internships are paid (rate not posted)
deadline_text: School-year programs run September to May. No 2026-27 application dates are posted. Contact Girls Inc.
how_to_apply: Use the apply links on the School-Year and Summer Programs pages. The school-year form is labeled 2025-26, so ask if it is current. Use the Contact Us page for questions. Office: 510 16th St, Oakland.
notes: A home page post describes Code the Game, a six-week coding program for grades 10 to 12. It does not say how to sign up. Internship pay, hours and ages are not posted.
